title: Synthetic example of a governed review workflow

eligibility.study_characteristics: Include empirical evaluations; exclude opinion-only reports.
eligibility.report_characteristics: Include English-language research reports. Document other restrictions before approval.

publication_period.basis: Illustrative dates only; the researcher must choose an appropriate period.

search_strategy.strategy: Illustrative free-text query; replace and pilot it before real use.

selection_process: Two reviewers screen independently; the assigned adjudicator resolves conflicts with recorded reasons.
data_items: Study design, setting, evidence relevant to the research questions, outcomes and limitations.
data_collection_process: Extract source-linked information and independently verify it. Record missing or unclear information explicitly.
risk_of_bias: Select and document a tool appropriate to the actual study designs; do not infer methodological adequacy from this example.

synthesis.criteria: Group studies only where comparisons are meaningful.
synthesis.non_quantitative: Structured narrative synthesis with links to supporting studies.
